headline: Argentina Stocks Decline as Country Risk Gauge Reaches 2026 High
summary: Argentina’s Merval stock index fell as country risk jumped over 40 points to 787, marking a 2026 high.
why: Country risk gauges measure the perceived likelihood of a sovereign debt default, directly impacting the borrowing costs of domestic companies and overall equity valuations in emerging markets.
why_moved: An increase in Argentina's country risk gauge to a 2026 high drove selling pressure on local equities.
